description: Structured eval definitions for the AppConfig Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across AppConfig topologies (linear deployment with alarms and validators, exponential with feature flags and schema validation, all-at-once for non-critical configs, missing deployment strategy prerequisite failure, missing configuration profile prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Linear AppConfig deployment with Lambda validator and CloudWatch alarm rollback
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — linear deployment strategy, 20% growth, 10-minute bake, Lambda validator, CloudWatch alarm for rollback
eval_cases.prompt: Create an AppConfig application named my-app-config in us-east-1. Environment: production. Configuration profile: app-settings (JSON). Deployment strategy: linear, 20% growth factor, 10-minute bake time. Attach a Lambda validator (config-validator function). Configure a CloudWatch alarm (appconfig-deploy-error-rate) for rollback during bake time. Application ID abc12345. Environment ID def67890. Profile ID ghi11111. Strategy ID jkl22222. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APPCONFIG: my-app-config (abc12345) / production (def67890)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Application: my-app-config (abc12345)
  [✓] Environment: production (def67890)
  [✓] Configuration profile: app-settings (ghi11111) — type: AWS.AppConfig.JSON
  [✓] Deployment strategy: linear-20pct-10min (jkl22222) — LINEAR growth=20% bake=10min
  [✓] Lambda validator: config-validator
  [✓] CloudWatch alarms: appconfig-deploy-error-rate [monitored during bake time]
  [✓] Rollback on alarm: enabled (auto-rollback during bake time)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws appconfig get-application --application-id abc12345
  aws appconfig get-deployment-strategy --deployment-strategy-id jkl22222

eval_cases.name: Exponential AppConfig deployment with feature flags, validators, and schema validation
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — exponential deployment strategy, feature flag schema, Lambda validator, JSON schema validation
eval_cases.prompt: Create an AppConfig application named feature-flag-platform in us-east-1. Environment: staging. Configuration profile: feature-flag-store with feature flag schema. Deployment strategy: exponential, 2% growth factor, 10-minute bake time. Attach a Lambda validator (flag-validator function). Enable JSON schema validation for flag structure. Tags: Environment=staging, Application=feature-platform.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APPCONFIG: feature-flag-platform / staging
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Configuration profile: feature-flag-store — type: AWS.Freeform
  [✓] Deployment strategy: EXPONENTIAL growth=2% bake=10min
  [✓] Feature flags: enabled
  [✓] JSON schema validation: enabled
  [✓] Lambda validator: flag-validator

eval_cases.name: All-at-once AppConfig deployment for non-critical YAML configuration
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — all-at-once deployment (100% growth, 0-minute bake) for non-critical development YAML config
eval_cases.prompt: Create an AppConfig application named simple-config-app in us-east-1. Environment: development. Configuration profile: banner-text (YAML, free form). Deployment strategy: all-at-once (100% growth, 0-minute bake). This is a non-critical development config for UI banner text. Tags: Environment=development.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APPCONFIG: simple-config-app / development
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Configuration profile: banner-text — type: AWS.Freeform
  [✓] Deployment strategy: all-at-once growth=100% bake=0min
  [✓] Rollback on alarm: disabled (bake time = 0)

eval_cases.name: AppConfig deployment with missing deployment strategy (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — no deployment strategy specified; cannot start deployment without one
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a new configuration version to AppConfig application abc12345, environment def67890. Configuration profile ghi11111, version 5. No deployment strategy specified. Just deploy it to production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APPCONFIG: (abc12345) / (def67890)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Deployment strategy: MISSING — cannot start deployment without a strategy (growth factor, bake time)

eval_cases.name: AppConfig deployment with missing configuration profile (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — no configuration profile or version exists; deployment requires a profile and version
eval_cases.prompt: Create an AppConfig deployment for application my-app-config (abc12345), environment production (def67890). Use deployment strategy linear-20pct-10min (jkl22222). No configuration profile has been created yet — just deploy what we have.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APPCONFIG: my-app-config (abc12345) / production (def67890)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Configuration profile: MISSING — no profile exists; must create a profile and version before deploying
